# Add offline diff-phase coverage for refresh_scoped_snapshot wiring

## Problem

The live DC lane catches the f449 bug, but replacing the `run_differs.py` diff-phase `refresh_scoped_snapshot(ctx)` call with a no-op survived the offline `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` suite when this ticket was filed. The overlay behavior has coverage; its wiring into the diff phase needed an offline regression oracle.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An offline regression test fails if `run_differs.py` stops invoking `refresh_scoped_snapshot(ctx)` during the diff phase.
- [ ] The test uses existing offline fixtures/fakes and does not require the live Jira DC lane.
- [ ] The targeted offline reconciler tests pass with the real `refresh_scoped_snapshot` wiring intact.

## Testing

Run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_run_differs_wires_refresh_scoped_snapshot_79a4.py`. If the coverage already exists on current `main`, verify it in a fresh worktree and close with no new code change.
